exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

effects.chain_continues_while: a new valid enemy is within current chain range

favorable_scene_effect.qualitative: no direct boss increase; requires chain density supporting more than five victims

rules.text: Removes the five-target cap. The arc continues jumping until no new valid enemy is within current chain range.
Damage does not diminish across jumps and no enemy may be hit twice by one activation.
Expected effect: no direct boss increase and approximately +40–150% horde throughput when chain density supports more than five victims.
